name: Score LinkedIn ICP leads and draft outreach with Claude, Notion and Sheets

parameters.content:
# LinkedIn ICP research and outreach drafts

Queue people searches in Notion. This workflow retrieves profiles with Periodix, scores fit with Claude, drafts two messages for qualified leads, and stores every outcome for review. It never sends LinkedIn outreach.

## Before enabling
Select the four required credentials, finish Central Configuration and create the Notion database and spreadsheet tabs. Review your ICP criteria and generated drafts before enabling the hourly schedule.

## Meaningful stages
1. Validate configuration and read Pending Notion searches.
2. Submit one people search and poll to completion with a finite limit.
3. Preserve Unicode, canonicalize person URLs and deduplicate within the search.
4. Score one profile at a time using structured model output.
5. Draft messages only for validated, qualified scores.
6. Upsert each result with RAW input and read it back exactly.
7. Reconcile every profile, read back the search audit, then mark the correct Notion page Done.

Uncertain or failed scoring/drafting stays Pending. Genuine low scores are Rejected.

# Setup checklist

## Four credentials
- Notion API: select on both Notion nodes. Share the database with that integration.
- Google Sheets OAuth2: select on all four Sheets nodes.
- Anthropic API: select on both Claude HTTP nodes.
- HTTP Header Auth for Periodix: name Authorization, value Bearer YOUR_PERIODIX_API_KEY. Select on both Periodix HTTP nodes. Keep the key in a credential, never in Central Configuration.

## Central Configuration
Enter the Notion database UUID, spreadsheet ID, connected Periodix profile ID, your product context and explicit 1-10 ICP criteria. Review model availability, threshold, search limit, queue size, polling interval and cap. Defaults retain the original 5/10 qualification threshold.

Notion properties: Sales Nav URL (URL), Status (select with Pending and Done), Campaign (rich text), Processed At (date). Only HTTPS LinkedIn Classic People or Sales Navigator People search URLs are accepted.

Periodix requires an existing account and connected LinkedIn profile. Sales Navigator URLs require the corresponding subscription. No community node is needed.

# Spreadsheet tabs and headers

Create two different tabs. Default names are Lead Review and Search Audit. Create exactly these headers in row 1, in this order. Do not rename them without updating the mappings.

## Lead Review
- Row Key
- Notion Page ID
- Search Result ID
- Search URL
- Campaign
- First Name
- Last Name
- Title
- Company
- Location
- Industry
- LinkedIn URL
- Score
- Reason
- Connection Note
- M1 Message
- Review Status
- Error
- Updated At

## Search Audit
- Notion Page ID
- Search Result ID
- Search URL
- Campaign
- Status
- Raw Results
- Duplicate Results
- Expected Profiles
- Durable Profiles
- Qualified Profiles
- Rejected Profiles
- Pending Profiles
- Error
- Updated At

Filter Lead Review by Review Status for Qualified, Rejected or Pending. Qualified rows contain both message drafts. Review Pending rows and the Search Audit error before retrying. Row Key is stable for a Notion page plus canonical LinkedIn URL, so retries update the same lead instead of appending another category row.

## 1. Queue and submit

Read only Pending people-search records. Outer batch size is explicitly one. Native HTTP uses the documented Periodix submit endpoint and stores its resultId. An unsuccessful submit is audited and leaves Notion Pending. Submission is not automatically retried, because it creates a paid search action.

## 2. Finite asynchronous search polling

Poll pending/completed/failed using the current resultId. Wait in seconds between polls. maxPolls limits the loop. A missing result array, provider failure, HTTP error or polling timeout becomes a Pending search audit. No callback webhook or public inbound endpoint is required.

The submit limit is the maximum returned profiles, not a promise of exhaustive LinkedIn coverage.

nodes.name: Stage 3: Profile Lineage and Loop Reset

parameters.content:
## 3. Normalize one search batch

Keep Unicode names and text. Canonicalize person URLs and deduplicate within this result. Missing person URLs remain Pending for manual review.

The profile loop resets only on a fresh search batch. Its return receipts set the reset flag false. Every profile carries its own Notion page ID and resultId. No loop source uses .first().

## 4. Strict structured results

Claude returns one named structured result. Score must be an integer 1-10 with a non-empty reason and no extra fields. Below-threshold valid scores are Rejected.

Qualified scores get a separate drafting request. Both drafts must be present, and the connection note must fit 200 characters. Truncated, malformed, blank or failed responses remain Pending rather than becoming a rejection or an empty successful draft.

Profile text is explicitly treated as untrusted data. Drafts still require human fact and tone review.

## 5. Save, read back, then issue a receipt

Upsert by stable Row Key. Every write explicitly uses Google Sheets RAW value input so profile text cannot become a formula. Manual column mapping prevents internal context from leaking into extra columns.

Read back the key and compare every saved column. Missing, duplicate or mismatched rows stop the workflow. Only the readback verifier returns a durable receipt to the loop.

Use one worker for this queue. Sheets upsert plus readback is idempotent for a serial retry, but is not a distributed transaction or a concurrency lock.

## 6. Correct completion per search

The profile loop done output contains all saved receipts. Reconciliation requires one unique receipt per expected profile, one search/page context, and zero Pending outcomes.

A valid empty result can complete, after its zero-count audit is saved and read back. Search failures and model uncertainty leave the Notion row Pending.

The correct page is marked Done only after the durable search audit. No execute-once shortcut or first-completed-item assumption is used.

## Deployment and review limits

Provide your own accounts, credentials, database, spreadsheet tabs, connected profile and product/ICP configuration. Confirm that your selected model is available to your account.

Run a single consumer for this Notion queue and prevent scheduled overlap using your instance deployment controls before activation. A failed job keeps Notion Pending, but retrying a search may incur another Periodix charge and re-score its profiles.

The ledger reflects the latest attempt. Existing duplicate keys must be cleaned up manually because readback deliberately refuses ambiguity. There is no automatic outreach, contact enrichment beyond returned search fields, or cross-campaign suppression.

Finished execution payload saving is disabled to avoid retaining profiles and draft prompts in n8n history. Waiting executions may still require temporary runtime persistence. Use the two ledgers for durable outcomes and configure retention deliberately if troubleshooting is needed.

Provider API reference: docs.actions.periodix.net/reference/post_v1-actions-linkedin-search-v1 and get_v1-actions-action-version-results-id.

Inspect both spreadsheet tabs and the exact Notion page after your first controlled run, then enable the hourly schedule.
